title: Scoped negative result: single-pair target borrowing in all-K complex cells
body:
**Scoped negative result / research note; no new κ.** In the all-but-one leaver cell, two targets cannot share source-dependent work if source values stay fixed, frames are monotone, no extra carriers exist, and all source-dependent target mixing stays within that one pair. The proof permits arbitrary read order, signed coefficients, cancellation and arbitrarily many pair interactions. A five-event ordering contradiction explains the obstruction.

The package adds only `research/complex-packet-borrowing23/`:

- Rebuilds the unchanged raw K492 constructor and checks the incidence and nonzero demand pattern in all **eight signed all-K cells**, using independent XOR-span enumeration: 504 nonempty joins and 3,600 shared-support instances.
- Checks all 120 orders of the proof's five-event witness. A separate exact scalar/frame replay checks all **720 orders** of a six-event three-source example: 120 satisfy the arbitrary-input scalar map, none has legal frames. Omitting source-frame propagation incorrectly accepts 60.
- Gives an explicit **two-carrier escape** in the three-source projection, with all eight dirty-input columns checked in forward and inverse-transpose orientations. Compensation, cleanup and final climbs are included. Relative to the direct circuit on the same stock, its profile changes by `2 H2 + 2 H7 - 2 H9`, a strict moment loss for every `0 < s < 1`.
- Includes a legal missing-demand control, three rejected scalar mutations, source pins, the randomized assignment and exploratory search coverage.

### Reproduce

Python 3.11+, standard library only, from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B research/complex-packet-borrowing23/verify.py
```

Expected first line: `PASS_COMPLEX_PACKET_PAIR_BORROWING_OBSTRUCTION_AND_PAID_ESCAPE`.

Validation passed on Windows with Python **3.13.5 and 3.14.0**, including isolated optimized execution. A minimal relocated checkout passed with an unrelated working directory and `PYTHONOPTIMIZE=2`; the constructor worker explicitly preserves assertions. Altered inherited source, corrupted expected evidence and changed candidate-selection hashes were rejected. The selected-record verifier and staged whitespace checks passed. Source pins also match the exact Git blobs at the base commit. No full supplier admission, global cold replay or proof-assistant formalization is claimed.

### Scope and related work

This extends beyond #651's own-first restriction for the particular mechanism of repeated mixing within one target pair. #683 concerns mixed K/M cells with pure carriers; this result concerns all-K cells and target borrowing. Concurrent #775 explores coupled partial entering-copy exchanges on P6k4, a different fixed rewrite class. Pre-submission PR metadata was refreshed through #779.

The proof does **not** cover additional carriers, mutable sources, source-dependent mixing through three or more targets, lifetime resets or different demands. Broader positive-circuit searches timed out; the discovery log assigns them no impossibility conclusion. The paid control establishes neither optimality nor a minimum helper count. Existing supplier and all-size analytic assumptions remain.

Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. OS assignment seed **23**, complex-supplier track; the recorded six-word salt selected pair `(6,7)`, sign `+1`. No pinned coordination issue existed, so the claim is local. Existing files, selected certificates and `upstream/` are unchanged.

Credit: icekylinx's #531 factory and ancestry; Jeremy Kothe/AtomScout's #622 constructor; Chafik Boukhalfa's #626 owner repair; eumemic's #543 and the retained community dependencies.
